_doc: F-216: fixes applied by `zep model curate` (and the model picker's panes) to community-pack files it ships. Keyed by lowercase path. base_sha256 = the pack file the recipe was written for: a different file (pack update) skips the recipe with a warning. 'ship' = extra files the fixed model needs, taken from the same option's sources. Ops: cli/lib/m2_ops.py.

creature/golemstone/golemcannonstone.m2.note: Texture 1 (the reflection layer the body batch combines with its skin) lost its filename in conversion: type 0, empty name -> the golem draws black. Give it the reflection map its sibling golemstone.m2 in the same pack uses.

creature/gryphon/gryphon_mount.m2.note: The pack's gryphon_mount is the elite gryphon mesh. Texture 0 names CREATURE\ELITEGRYPHON\ELITEGRYPHON.BLP but is typed 11 (display skin), so the client ignores the name and paints the display's Gryphon_Skin (made for the regular gryphon) -> scrambled. Make it a fixed texture (type 0).

world/generic/centaur/passive doodads/ce.note: A conversion of Dragonflight's 10ct_centaur_hut01.wmo; texture 2 lost its filename (type 0, empty), so the roof cap (submesh 10) and a band (submesh 2) drew untextured. Retail's hut01 materials 2 / 10 use 10ct_centaur_hut01_3997709 (thatch) and _4005649 (wood poles), both shipped by the pack but named by no texture: the cap is thatch. (2026-10-07's guess hut02_4005634 belongs to the hut02 model: wrong roof.) The converter also kept only the first texture of each two-layer WMO material (shader 13 + grey_07 detail).

world/kalimdor/ashenvale/passivedoodads/.note: Not a remaster: the pack swapped in a Legion Azsuna tree (2,004 vertices; stock and retail are a 200-vertex Ashenvale tree). Texture 0 lost its filename (type 0, empty), which the 3.3.5 client draws solid white. The trunk batch reads it alone (flat white trunk); the canopy batch reads it UNDER 7an_treeleaves_01, where white is right. So the trunk gets its own texture - retail 7an_tree_c01.blp (1030117, shipped beside the leaves) added as texture 2 and the trunk's lookup slot pointed at it - and the canopy's first layer reads the leaves too (white under the leaves drew a white canopy in the picker). (2026-10-15's fix named texture 0 itself: the canopy drew as bark.)

world/kalimdor/durotar/passivedoodads/ro.note: Its texture name is written twice back to back ('...6ar_wmocladding02.blpworld\\...6ar_wmocladding02.blp', one length over both): no file has that name, so the rock drew black in the picker and gets no texture in game. Named once; the pack ships 6ar_wmocladding02.blp (Warlords Ashran cladding).
